title: Throw It!
description: Throw literally anything. TNT explodes, spawn eggs hatch, buckets empty, weapons deal damage, and Netherite tools mine a 3×3 area. Press R and find out.
body:
# ThrowIt

**Throw literally anything — and watch what happens.**

ThrowIt adds a single keybind (default: **R**) that lets you throw whatever item you're currently holding. What happens next depends on what you threw.

## Features

- 🧨 **TNT & explosive blocks** — explode on impact, just like the real thing.
- 🥚 **Spawn eggs** — hatch the mob the instant they land, exactly like right-clicking one.
- 🪣 **Water / Lava / Powder Snow buckets** — empty their contents wherever they land, leaving you an empty bucket to pick back up.
- ⚔️ **Weapons & tools** — deal damage based on the item's real attack power when they hit a mob or player, then drop on the ground so you can retrieve them, just like a thrown arrow.
- ⛏️ **Netherite tools** — throw a Netherite pickaxe, axe, or shovel at a wall, floor, or ceiling and it mines a full 3×3 area on impact (only blocks that tool can actually harvest), then drops for you to pick back up.
- 📦 **Everything else** — lands safely on the ground as a normal item, ready to be picked up.

Every throw is server-authoritative, so it works correctly and fairly in multiplayer.

## How to throw

Hold any item and press **R**. The key is rebindable from **Options → Controls → Throwit**.

## Configuration

Two values can be tuned in the mod's common config file:

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `throwExplosionPower` | `3.0` | Explosion strength of thrown TNT / explosive blocks |
| `throwDamageMultiplier` | `1.0` | Multiplier applied to damage dealt by thrown weapons/tools |

## Known limitations

- Mob buckets (axolotl, fish, tadpole) currently behave as regular thrown items — they don't release their mob yet. Planned for a future update.

## Compatibility

Designed to work alongside other mods — ThrowIt only adds a new keybind and a new projectile entity, it doesn't override or replace any vanilla item behavior.
